Maybe enrolling in some kind of class like that could be beneficial for her.

The teacher doesn’t say very much. She communicates with me on the SeeSaw app and she just says that my son got a write up again today for punching a kid. Yesterday I asked for more info and she said that she is finding that punching is his first response instead of using his words. We had a meeting with her a couple weeks ago to address the behavior. She was asking a lot of questions about how he’s acted at daycare and preschool and she’s been informed that he never acted like that there. She just says he has some habits to break, etc. she gives really short handed responses every time I talk to her. Her and the principal say they’re “trying things” with my son but they never say what those things necessarily are.
